notes.title: Suicide Runners Out Now!
notes.notes: Pilot your suicide runner on a quest to rid the galaxy of evil. Collect powerups and fight various bosses in this new shoot em up.

notes.title: New Boss
notes.notes: In Suicide Runners you will fight many enemies here is  another  one of them. This enemy can shoot various projectiles at you as well as charge you.

notes.title: MiniBoss
notes.notes: Your home planet is being invaded! And what is an alien invasion without flying saucers?

notes.title: New Enemy Type
notes.notes: In Suicide Runners you will fight many enemies here is  another  one of them. This enemy has a life force laser beneath him and shoots multiple shots at the same time.

notes.title: New Enemy Type
notes.notes: In Suicide Runners you will fight many enemies here is just one of them. This enemy shoots lasers to destroy the player. While the lasers do themselves do not follow the player, they do track last position , so watch out!
